transcriber_notes: Rows: 7 blocks as printed (總數; サイパン, ヤップ, パラオ, トラック, ポナペ, ヤルート支廳) x 11 years (大正 11 - 昭和 7); 11 occupation groups x 5 columns (總數, 邦人 男/女, 島民 男/女) = 55 figure columns. Left page (p. 160 / 162) carries 總數 ... 農業, right page (p. 161 / 163) 學生生徒 ... 無職 plus the 年次 column; the 學生生徒 columns sit at the very edge of the spread and are joined to 農業 by row. Block headings (總...數, サ イ パ ン, 支...廳 ...) are printed split across the gutter. The blocks 總數 to トラック are on p0114 (pp. 160-161), ポナペ and ヤルート on p0115 (pp. 162-163).
同 expanded in year labels. Printed dashes written as —. 昭和 / 大正 era names as printed; blank lines between year groups are not rows.

Rows marked '*' (e.g. '大正 13 *') are the printed second lines of small figures preceded by '*' under a year's row; the footnote says '* 印ハ從慶者ノ再揭ナリ' (figures re-listed, marked *; the 4th character is a glyph resembling 處/廏/慶, read as printed with doubt). Only cells that carry a figure on those lines are filled; the other cells of a '*' row are "" (empty in the original). The '*' itself is not repeated in the cells. The row-sum checks below cover the '*' rows too.

Placement of the ポナペ '*' line: it is printed on the same text line as the 昭和 1 row (compressed spacing, '*1 2' in 總數 and '1 *1 1' in 島民 女), but in every other block the '*' line follows its year row; it is entered under 大正 14 (as its total-block counterpart '15' = サイパン 14 + 1 requires). Treat as a placement judgement by the transcriber.
Edge column: the 島民 女 figures of 農業 (and some of 無職) are partly clipped at the fold of the scan but legible; they were read as printed (every row sum reconciles).

Row checks: for every block row and every occupation group, 總數 = 邦人 男 + 邦人 女 + 島民 男 + 島民 女; the first group (總數) equals the sum of the ten occupation groups; and the 總數 block equals the sum of the six 支廳 blocks, cell by cell. All of these reconcile EXCEPT one printed figure: サイパン 昭和 3, 總數 — 總數 prints '25' (read twice at high zoom) but 1 + 17 + 8 = 26 and the sum of the occupation groups is 26; the 總數 block prints 27 (= 邦人 2 + 島民 25), i.e. 26 from the branches. Entered as printed ('25'); a misprint in the source.

Faint readings (kept as printed): 總數 block 昭和 2 '20' and 昭和 4 '40' (first block) have a damaged right-hand edge on the 0 but read as printed. No cell is unreadable; no [?] used. Some cells that look blank at normal size show a faint dash on zoom and are written —; a small blemish (dot) at トラック 昭和 7 總數 is not a figure (the cell is a dash).
Editor: the 4th character of the footnote (從?者) could not be read with confidence and is shown as [?].

en.d: Gives the number of persons issued passports by sex, split between Japanese and islanders, by occupation (commerce and others), by year from 1922, in total and by branch office.
